name: Mouwasat Medical Services
note: Hospital and medical-center group (healthcare, a hard Gate 2 exclusion). It operates pharmacies, but these are hospital dispensaries integrated into its medical operations, not a standalone consumer retail pharmacy chain like Nahdi or Al Dawaa (the only pharmacy carve-out).

name: Al Safi Danone | الصافي دانون
note: Saudi dairy manufacturer that produces and distributes to roughly 30,000 third-party retail stores across 11 countries. No dedicated consumer store network or branded D2C e-commerce; products reach consumers on other retailers' shelves (Saudi Radwa pattern).

name: RCIT Holding Co.
note: This is Al Rubaiyat Company for Industry & Trade Holding, a Jeddah, KSA retail conglomerate whose divisions are all retail-qualifying: Rubaiyat luxury fashion, Brands for Less, Rubaiyat Home furniture, and Sarawat Superstores grocery, with 2,000+ staff and physical stores. Excluded purely on the 'Holding' name-pattern; qualifies at parent level per Gate 6 like Jarir Group/Starco.

name: Unified Real Estate Development Company
note: Riyadh-based real estate developer of shopping centers and residential complexes (The Esplanade, Town Square). It develops and manages property as a landlord/developer, a hard Gate 2 exclusion; it is not itself a retailer.

name: Halwani Brothers
note: Saudi food manufacturer (tahini, halawa, processed meats, dairy) that distributes through supermarkets and third-party channels (Noon, Carrefour, Amazon). Company site is corporate; no own-branded retail stores or e-commerce cart of its own (Radwa/Halwani distribution pattern).

name: Alshaya Enterprises
note: This is the B2B interiors and building-products arm of Alshaya Group: turnkey fit-out, commercial furnishings, wholesale building materials and sanitaryware sold on a project/installation model. Hard Gate 2 exclusion (fit-out/construction materials/B2B), and distinct from the retail Alshaya franchise group which is folded in elsewhere per Gate 6.

name: Al Jameel International Co. Ltd
note: Jeddah wholesale trader and manufacturer of nuts, spices, pulses, dried fruit, tahini and halva with five processing factories and import/export to 50+ countries. A data-provider 'grocery retail' tag notwithstanding, the actual model is B2B wholesale plus manufacturing, with no dedicated consumer store or D2C e-commerce found.

name: Alyasra Foods
note: Kuwait B2B foodservice and FMCG distribution/logistics company; its D2C is only one of four business segments and the site shows no substantial standalone consumer store. The genuinely retail Alyasra Fashion (270+ stores) is a separate entity on its own domain (alyasra.com) that would need its own account row per Gate 6.

name: ALJOMAIH BOTTLING PLANTS
note: PepsiCo franchise bottler and metal-packaging (can) manufacturer serving 46,000+ B2B customers via distribution. Manufacturing/bottling with no consumer retail stores or e-commerce; correctly excluded.

name: AlJammaz Group
note: Diversified Saudi conglomerate mixing B2B tech distribution (AlJammaz Technologies), power/electrical, construction materials, real estate, manufacturing and agriculture. Parent excluded per Gate 6 (mixes retail with hard-excluded lines); no substantial dedicated consumer retail operation identifiable on this parent domain.

name: Arrow Food Group
note: FMCG importer, distributor and manufacturer (Arrow Juice/Beverage factories) serving 20,000+ third-party points of sale. Self-describes 'distribution, manufacturing and retail,' but the concrete operation is B2B distribution to other retailers plus manufacturing, with no own consumer store chain or D2C e-commerce found.

name: KDD
note: Beyond dairy/ice-cream manufacturing, KDD runs its own dedicated consumer retail arm: a live B2C store at eshop.kddc.com (100+ SKUs, KWD cart/checkout, free shipping), the DUKKAN convenience-store chain across Kuwait, and branded 'Gate-Shop' ice-cream parlors. Corrected Gate 2 hybrid pattern (Lazurde/Aljazierah): qualifies on the retail arm's own merits.

name: Qatar Vacancies
note: Jobs/recruitment and classifieds portal (employment-placement and web-portal NAICS, name 'Qatar Vacancies'). Not an eCommerce retailer; no product-retail dimension exists.

name: Abu Khalifa Trading
note: Doha, Qatar fresh fruit and vegetable wholesale distributor (exclusive agent for Blue Whale and Dole), operating out of the Al Sailiya wholesale market. Genuinely B2B wholesale/distribution with no consumer retail arm; correctly excluded on category.

name: Tawar Mall
note: Physical shopping mall in Doha (300,958 sqm, 300+ tenant brands). Mall/landlord is a hard Gate 2 exclusion; any e-commerce/delivery belongs to individual tenants (e.g. Jumbo), not a mall-operated retail platform.

name: kuwait jobs now
note: Jobs/recruitment board by name, with no domain on file and nothing retail to verify. Non-retail and unverifiable, so correctly out (Gate 7 default-out).

name: Naqi water | نقي للمياه
note: Unayzah, Saudi bottled-water producer (primarily manufacturing) that also runs its own-brand consumer delivery app plus website. It is a single narrow product line, so it hinges on the Gate 5b app path (50k+ installs), which could not be confirmed after repeated attempts (store pages JS-rendered/blocked). Genuinely unresolved.

name: KUWAIT PROTEINS CO.
note: B2B FMCG distributor in Kuwait (1,500+ products across 75 brands: McCain, Alpro, etc.) supplying supermarkets, HoReCa, wholesalers and convenience stores. It supplies retail channels rather than operating its own consumer stores; correctly excluded on category.

name: Nashar Trading Company
note: Jeddah food manufacturer and FMCG distributor (processed meat, sterilized dairy, ghee, frozen, catering) marketing its own and international brands through retail channels. No dedicated consumer store network or D2C e-commerce of its own.

name: Impact46
note: Riyadh venture-capital and asset-management firm (CMA-authorized; portfolio includes Jahez, Tamara, Syarah). Financial/capital services, a hard Gate 2 exclusion; not retail in any form.

name: Mayar Foods
note: Dammam food distributor and brand-owner (Punjabi Al-Muhaidib, White Swan, Milagrosa rice and other staples) selling through third-party retailers. Explicitly no branded retail locations or e-commerce cart; distribution model only.

name: Basamh Group
note: Saudi FMCG distribution and manufacturing group (own brands Goody, Cofique, Treva; distributes Betty Crocker, Nature Valley, etc.) supplying wholesalers, retailers, pharmacies and e-commerce platforms. Products reach consumers via other retailers; no dedicated own-store retail arm.

name: Alfalak Electronic Equipment & Supplies Co.
note: B2B IT and communications systems integrator/distributor (system integration, networking, business solutions) serving government, universities and banks. Despite the 'Electronic Equipment' name it is not a consumer electronics retailer; B2B services/tech exclusion.

name: SPIMACO
note: Saudi Pharmaceutical Industries and Medical Appliances Corporation, a pharmaceutical manufacturer (drug and medical-appliance production, matching the NAICS). It is a producer, not a consumer retail pharmacy chain, so the pharmacy carve-out does not apply. Site returned transient 503s but the manufacturer identity is well established.
